description: Ouvrages hydrauliques liés aux conduites d'alimentation des voies navigables appartenant à la région Bretagne is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ows.region-bretagne.fr. Hydraulic works related to the supply lines of Boulet (35) and Porzo (56) of the waterways belonging to the Brittany region. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Hydraulic works related to waterway supply lines belonging to the Brittany region" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Porzo, ouvrage conduite, vidange, données ouvertes, purge, Boulet. The listing shows 2014-12-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
